stem:
Read this sentence from paragraph 1.

Thanks to my abilities, the rear end of our station wagon has seen pine trees, poles, and snow banks, all up-close and personal.

In this sentence the author —

options.label: F
options.text: shares her fear of never getting a driver's license

options.label: G
options.text: explains why she is such a poor driver

options.label: H
options.text: makes fun of her lack of skill

options.label: J
options.text: describes the place where she lives
